name: The Assault of Gallus, 66 AD - Introductory Scenario

game.night_cite: card turn track shades 8-10; victory conditions: 'played for ten turns (only the first seven of which may be day turns)'
game.opening_cite: card: 'The game begins with a Roman Fire Phase (4.12)'

deployment.cite: card: Judaeans set up first inside the New City on or within its outer walls; Romans set up second anywhere outside Jerusalem no closer than five hexes from any Elevated Hex after observing the Judaean deployment
deployment.min_force_cite: special rule 1: >= 1 unit in each Bastion and Fortress of the North Wall O50..QQ29 inclusive (Forts count: 'Fortresses and Forts are considered identical' [2.11]); requirement void from the start of turn 4; a hex vacated by combat results need not be reoccupied
deployment.roman_prohibited_cite: card: Roman entry of Garrison Areas is not allowed (e.g., Romans may never enter P50 or QQ32)

playable_area.note: playable = New City crescent + the outside region (flood fill from A25, barred by Elevated hexes and the crescent, and by the two southern_bound diagonals) + every Elevated hex bordering that ground. The bound's anchors are the card's own arc ends: 'The scenario is played only on the North Wall from O50 to Women's Gate to QQ31' - west flank capped at O50's printed number (50), east flank at the QQ31/QQ32 junction (32). The Old City south of the Second Wall is OFF the battlefield and its terrain is deliberately unencoded (A4 hard bound, Bruce's ruling 2026-08-09; leak evidence = ingest/builtup_evidence.json, 219 reachable Old City art hexes typed clear pre-bound). Routed/Panicked units whose Refuge path leaves the battlefield exit at the south gates and are removed from play (Bruce-approved scope call 2026-08-07; flagged for module-author expert review).

reinforcement.cite: special rule 2: from turn 4, at the start of the Judaean MPh roll the dice and randomly draw that many units plus the Giora Leader from the South Wall force; odd entry roll = Tadi Gate (OO33), even = Q49; if blocked, enter at the other Gate; repeat each turn until all have entered. Count = two dice per source-defect entry 'gallus-reinforcement-dice-count' (declared interpretation, expert review pending).

vp.cite: special rule 3: Romans win if they control (18.3) ten Built-up hexes at the end of any Judaean Melee Phase; hex control = last occupant [18.3]; Judaeans win by avoiding the Roman victory conditions through turn 10 (or Roman concession)

oob_cite: printed scenario card (module board Intro.jpg) - counts byte-verified identical to the module's Gallus .vsav force pool (ingest/gallus_oob.json); 'The Giora Faction and two Zealots are removed temporarily as the garrison of the South Wall'

[14.2x, 15.1-15.3] retreat engine: MF-budget constrained search with per-hex Refuge routing and safe-route preference, cannot-retreat elimination verified by exhaustive search, 14.21 one-hex cap with forced-overstack elimination

[2.45, 8.3, 8.6, 10.11] Siege Engines: locked pushing-crew stack moved as one action, crew0 start-of-MPh condition, tracked Directional-Arrow facing with free crewed pivots, breach attacks only vs the Facing-arrow hex, white side = MA 0

[9.51, 9.52, 11.17, card LOF] LOF completion: siege-Tower hex = Fortress,Tower group on both axes, closer-to tiebreaks bound to B/W obstacles only, exact 9.51 Built-up-adjacent-to-ground-end blocks, 9.52 slope/elevation LOF (printed example reproduced), 11.17 crest melee halving on the 182 art-derived crest hexsides

[8.94, 8.95, 12.4; The General 26-4 p.13] Interior roads: 105 art-derived city road hexsides (ingest/road_hexsides.json - detector sweep + full contact-sheet adjudication, centerline rule), road rate 1/2 MF replacing the terrain entry cost, Cavalry/Artillery Built-up entry AND exit locked to road hexsides; roads outside Jerusalem destroyed per 8.94 (none encoded); gate hexes carry no road sides - 8.91 entrance costs govern

[11.4, 13.21, 14.5] Wreck/Elim markers: every elimination runs through one door - eliminated Siege Engines leave a Wreck, eliminated non-Cauldron Artillery an Elim marker (Cauldrons nothing); markers hold the dead unit's stacking slot to scenario end, block similar units from moving into/through the hex, count as full-to-them in retreats, and a wrecked Tower still lifts and obstructs LOF as if standing; Judaean ground-level entry into an unescorted Siege Engine hex is legal and wrecks it (the 11.4 carve-out of 8.11; melee through the Ramp hexside from an Elevated hex likewise wrecks an unescorted engine, without dice). The 13.21-vs-14.5 marker-identity conflict for Artillery: proven outcome-equivalent inside Gallus, registered in source_defects, campaign identity escalated (R7)

[11.9, 11.81, 11.87, 14.3] Multiple Attacks: victorious melee attackers advance into the vacated hex through a modal advance-or-decline step (enemy ZOC and Command Control ignored for that hex, terrain and stacking still checked) and carry the A/B/C Multiple Attack marker ladder - an advanced unit must Melee into its ZOC when enemies stand there, a marked attacker re-opens an already-attacked hex and brings already-spent partners with it, a B-marked attack removes every A marker, a markerless attack removes all markers, markers die with the Melee Phase; the 11.81 once-per-hex melee lock; Continuous Combat re-attacks require the exact same unit set; an auto-resolved lone-defender melee Disrupt now takes its immediate 14.3 retreat; the official Q&A's retreat-adjacent attack permission holds

[6.5, 8.7, 5.3, 16.3, 7.2, 9.31, 9.4] Escalades - movement and state: a Fresh Heavy Infantry or Velitae Base places an Escalade for 4 MF (adjacent to Elevated, 6.5 occupant whitelist, one Base per hex, in Command Control, not Disrupted) and is locked in place until it removes the ladder (4 MF, no one on top); up to two units climb above per the printed capacity and the two-units-per-phase Fully-Occupied cap (marker face resets at phase end); climbers scale into any adjacent Elevated hex at a flat 2 MF, descend free beyond entry cost, and may not shift ladder-to-ladder; a Disrupted or eliminated Base loses the Escalade at once and its climbers drop into the hex; escalade hexes exert no ZOC and neither do Romans stacked with a Siege Engine; errant fire can never disrupt a Base with climbers; no missile fire from an Escalade hex; MF spend now accumulates across all of a unit's actions in one Movement Phase (each action no longer drew a fresh full allowance)

[9.12, 14.33, 14.4] Escalades - fire: missile attacks against an Escalade hex resolve on the printed clear/slope/ramp/Escalade row with the Base unit ineligible for losses until it is the only unit left in the hex to absorb them; a DD against a lone eligible target (one unit atop the ladder, or any lone defender) eliminates it outright rather than disrupting twice; E-chains spill onto the Base only after every other unit is gone; one unit can never voluntarily absorb both halves of a DD while another eligible target remains (this 14.33 bar was silently missing for ALL hexes and is now enforced everywhere)

[11.6, 11.61, 11.62, 11.81, 11.85, 8.7, 16.3] Escalades - melee: an Escalade hex is attacked per level and never in a combined attack - from Elevated hexes (11.61: only the climbers can be struck, they defend at half strength, the Base and anything beneath it can neither be hit nor add to the defense, excess results are forfeit, and the attacker can never advance) or from Ground/Gate/Built-up hexes (11.62: the Base alone defends at half strength, climbers add nothing, yet combat results fall on the climbers first and reach the Base only when it is the last unit in the hex); each level may be attacked once per Melee Phase - the printed two-battles exception to the once-per-hex lock; units atop a ladder attack at half strength and only into adjacent Elevated hexes, the Base may never attack; a victorious climber may advance off the ladder into the vacated Elevated hex, and at the end of the Roman Melee Phase any Fresh climber adjacent to a vacant Elevated hex may move onto it through a mandatory choose-or-decline step; a Judaean defender can never count an adjacent Escalade as a flank-attack escape route because the Roman Base always occupies it

[3.4, 6.1, 6.6, 6.61, 8.8, 8.96, 9.4, 11.5, 13.2, 13.3, 14.31, 15.2, 16.4, 5.3, 7.2] Testudo: two or three Fresh Heavy Infantry of one Legion (or two with a Fresh Velitae) form at 6 MF each in the Roman Movement Phase or at setup (3.4, free), one HQ stacks within; the formation moves as one stack at MA 4 (Disrupted members do not slow it; the forming-MPh remainder is min(4, MA-8 members' leftover) = 2 MF unmoved, per the registered 8.8 arithmetic defect) and may never enter an occupied, Elevated, or Built-up hex (even on a road) - except passing, never stopping, through a Roman-occupied-or-controlled Gate via its Entrance hexsides; a Breach only next to a connecting Breach (8.96, now enforced for Testudos, Cavalry, Artillery, and Siege Engines alike); entering the hex IS joining (6 MF flat, capacity and Legion checked, Disrupted Velitae and non-Panicked HQ admitted per 16.4 over 6.61's incomplete list - registered defect), joining before it moves locks it for the MPh; leaving forfeits half the unit's MA and may not drop it below two Fresh Heavy Infantry; disband only before moving, 6 MF to each Fresh occupant (Disrupted free); no ZOC while intact and no assembly/disassembly out of Command Control; missile fire resolves on the Testudo target row (Broken Testudo one row lower) with the 13.3 Fresh-HI -1 suppressed on both faces; only the Velitae inside can ever fire (structural: no other missile class may join); units in a Testudo may not Melee attack and are attacked only from Ground/Gate/Built-up hexes; melee Disrupts in a Fortress, Testudo, or Siege Engine hex retreat at the owner's option (14.31 modal choose-or-decline - the Fortress option was silently denied and the Siege-Engine exemption silently missing before this); retreats may join at 6 MF and end there; fewer than two Fresh Heavy Infantry or any Panicked occupant breaks the formation at once: the Broken Testudo marker costs its Fresh units 6 MF in the next Roman Movement Phase and leaves at that phase's end, Broken members with any Fresh unit exert ZOC again

[8.4, 8.5, 9.1, 16.2] Artillery flip-to-move: Fresh Roman Artillery cannot move (MA 0) - a free voluntary flip in its own Movement Phase turns it to the Disrupted side, reflecting its vulnerability in transit, and it then moves at the Disrupted allowance; it cannot fire again until rallied (fire is Fresh-only, artillery rallying is optional); Cauldrons never flip - they move Fresh or Disrupted between Elevated hexes; Roman Artillery starting the Assault Period on an Elevated hex cannot arise (the deployment zone holds none)

[8.1, 4.13, 15.3, 17.21] Rout and Panic movement obligations: a Routed or Panicked unit must spend its full Disrupted movement allowance moving towards Refuge each friendly Movement Phase, every hex entered strictly closer - the phase cannot end while such a move remains available, and a unit with no legal closer step remains in place (17.21's own escape clause); once it reaches a road with an unobstructed path to Refuge it must remain on that road until Refuge (obstruction by enemy units or their ZOC frees it - Judaean roads only, the Roman Refuge is the board edge and exterior roads are destroyed); Panicked units move only after everyone else - refused while a Routed unit's mandatory move is unmet, and any Panicked move ends all other friendly movement for the phase; any unit entering a hex with a Panicked unit stops and its Movement Phase ends there, and if that forced stop overstacks the hex the entering unit is eliminated (a mandatory Refuge move is never allowed to do so)

[11.82, 11.86, 11.9, 14.33] Excess-'E' advance bonus and loss forfeits: combat results the defender cannot legally absorb are forfeit under a per-pick eligibility guard (an excess result can never land on a live but immune unit - for example the undeclared level of a Tower), and each 'E' that eliminated no unit earns the victorious melee attackers one extra hex of advance beyond the vacated hex at no MF cost; the bonus advance obeys every normal entry restriction, may never leave a hex in enemy ZOC, requires Command Control, respects stacking where it ends, captures every hex entered, and the advancing units carry their Multiple Attack markers

[5.1, 5.2, 5.3, 16.51] Command Control exact tracing and phase-start determination: CC is determined once at the beginning of each phase - a unit that begins the phase in CC keeps it for that phase even if its HQ then moves or dies, CC gained mid-phase waits for the next determination, and a reinforcement entrant is determined at entry; the trace runs from each HQ along a path of hexes that HQ could itself legally move through - the full terrain, gate, and class movement law, enemy occupancy (an unescorted enemy Siege Engine hex stays traceable from ground level, which could enter and wreck it), a non-Fresh HQ's own bar on entering enemy ZOC, Escalade hexes at capacity, and hexes holding an intact Testudo or a Panicked unit as terminal-only (they receive CC but the HQ would have to stop, so the trace ends there); a Fresh HQ is never stopped by enemy ZOC; the rulebook's own flanked-Wall example is reproduced as a pinned validator case

[6.4, 6.41, 6.42, 8.3, 8.61, 9.1, 9.4, 9.11, 10.11, 11.2, 11.21, 11.22, 11.3, 11.4, 15.2] Tower riding and boarding: units board a Tower below (two Heavy Infantry/Velitae pushers plus a HQ; entry and transit refused once two pushers stand there; Rams carry no passengers) or atop (one Infantry plus a HQ) for the hex's own terrain cost - climbing is free; the locked stack carries its riders, every unit atop loses two MF per MF the engine spends and later boarders pay that as the printed damage-number transit marker; riders move off (2 MF) or board from Elevated only through the ramp/Facing hexside, and any such crossing locks the Tower's movement and facing for the rest of the Movement Phase; a rider is never pushing crew; riders atop a Tower may fire (units beneath may not), and fire at a Tower hex declares pushers, riders, or both - the undeclared level is immune, a DD against the lone declared unit eliminates it outright, Cauldrons and rock-throwers may only target the pushers, both levels resolve on the Tower row, and the hex can be missile-attacked once per phase (no rider/pusher split attacks); the Siege Engine itself can never absorb fire or melee results; riders Melee adjacent Elevated hexes at doubled strength through the ramp hexside only, while every other Roman in a Tower or Ram hex may not attack at all; the Tower hex is meleed from Elevated only through the ramp hexside (riders alone defend, at normal strength) or from Ground/Gate/Built-up (pushers defend at normal strength, riders absorb the results first and defend at half strength if no pushers remain); an unescorted engine meleed through the ramp from Elevated is wrecked without dice, and an above-level battle that clears the hex of Romans destroys the Tower; ground-level victories never do; each level may be attacked once per Melee Phase (the printed second exception to the once-per-hex lock); Infantry never retreats into or through a Siege Engine hex with two pushing units; at the end of the Roman Melee Phase a rider adjacent to a vacant Elevated hex across the ramp may move onto it through the same choose-or-decline step Escalades use

[8.2, 7.321, 8.13, 6.1, 6.2, 6.3, 6.4, 8.4] Movement Phase doors: one-mover-at-a-time finality (a unit's movement is completed the moment another unit begins to move, cleared at each phase boundary), free soft-ZOC exit when the first hex entered is ZOC-free, the 8.13 fully-stacked carve-out (a hex still enterable by a HQ or Cauldron is not fully stacked to that entrant - all others pay double transit cost), Cavalry/flipped-Artillery/crewed-Ram pass-through of Roman-controlled Gates via Entrance hexsides with stopping refused, and the 6.1/6.2/6.3 ENTRY prohibitions enforced on every hex entered (Infantry never into Cavalry, Cavalry only into HQ-or-Cavalry hexes outside Gates, Artillery never into Siege Engine/Cavalry/Artillery hexes, one Cauldron per Fortress)

[11.14, 11.2, 11.3, 11.7, 11.18, 11.13, 11.1, Q&A 11.1, Q&A 11.81, Q&A 14.3] Melee completion: Gate occupants attack connected Elevated hexes normally, connected Breaches and Entrance-hexside Ground/Built-up targets at half strength - an Entrance-hexside attack opens the Gate as a Sortie, and if the defender still holds the sortied hex at the end of that Melee Phase he may counterattack the Gate across the Entrance hexside with a bonus Melee at normal strength (pushing units included, Tower riders and Escalade bases excluded; declining closes the Gate; a victorious counterattacker advancing into the emptied Gate takes it - the printed 'enemy occupation'); the -1 die-roll modifier benefitting an Elevated defender now applies unless the attack comes from a connected Elevated hex, Breach, Staircase, or Gate Entrance (its live cases: escalade assaults and Tower-rider attacks; Earth Ramps cannot exist in Gallus); ALL melee out of a Breach hex is at half strength (the Ground/Built-up half of 11.13 was silently missing); Heavy Infantry stacked with Foederatti or Syrian Archers can neither melee nor fire and vice versa, except across Tower elevations per the official Q&A; a Fresh Cauldron may melee attack an adjacent connected Elevated hex (the one legal artillery-class attack); a unit that just retreated into a hex defends it, and a DE result may eliminate the Disrupted unit while disrupting the Fresh one (both Q&A permissions proven end-to-end)
build_open: Every entry here is an OPEN coverage-matrix row - a defect that blocks playability, never a player-umpired corner. Full detail: COVERAGE_MATRIX.md (internal).
Rocks vs connected lower Elevated hexes (10.2 Bastion/Fortress case - gate currently refuses any Elevated rock target)

Movement options: 8.14 offboard exit (Romans as-if-Clear and out for the single Gallus Assault Period, Judaeans never return; 8.2 finality, soft-ZOC free exit, gate pass-through and the 8.13 carve-out are DONE)
Deployment options (artillery Fresh-or-Disrupted, off-board Legion setup; setup-in-Testudo is DONE; the in-game flip action itself is DONE; Command Control exact tracing is DONE)

Blocked on module-author answers: Garrison Area extents, testudo one-per-legion limit (the formation machinery is DONE; only the counter-mix count question holds this cell), fort staircase hexsides, Giora dice count (Elim-vs-Wreck no longer blocks Gallus: outcome-equivalence proven, R7 stays open for campaign scope)
rulings: Official Q&A (The General Question Box + 1/6/1992 AH typescript) is the authority tier above the rulebook text; the two documents AGREE everywhere (decode-prep 6, item by item) - their one discrepancy is a rule-citation mismatch (17.23 vs 17.3) registered in source_defects

Bounded battlefield: the old city beyond the Second Wall is out of play; Routed/Panicked units exiting via the south gates toward Refuge are removed from play (scenario scope statement; Bruce-approved; module-author review pending)

Coverage-matrix regime (spec #13 as amended 2026-08-09): COVERAGE_MATRIX.md is the playability instrument. The scenario is playable only when every matrix row is ENFORCED or UNREACHABLE-with-evidence; nothing is left to a human umpire. Current verdict: NOT PLAYABLE - the build_open list above blocks release.
